answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The delta lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the trellis is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
